title: Owner creates a draft invoice for the fleet telematics deal
userProblem: Create a draft invoice for dls_002, the fleet telematics pilot deal with Bolt Logistics, for 210000 EUR due on 2027-01-15.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent creates a new invoice record for dls_002 with status draft, amount 210000 EUR, and due date 2027-01-15, and confirms the new invoice id.

assertions.description: Agent must call create_record for the new invoice.
Create targets the right deal and status.
Answer confirms the invoice was created.

rationale: Core create scenario: owner creates a new invoice, which owner is permitted to do.
